title: The Legend of Sleepy Hollow
sourceTitle: Washington Irving, “The Legend of Sleepy Hollow” (1820), retold

scenes.title: Hoofbeats
scenes.narration: Listen... hoofbeats, on a midnight road. A rider in the fog. And he has no head.

scenes.title: Sleepy Hollow, 1790
scenes.narration: Sleepy Hollow, New York, 1790. A drowsy valley, where folk swore the very air was bewitched.

scenes.title: Ichabod Crane
scenes.narration: Its schoolmaster was Ichabod Crane. Lanky as a runaway scarecrow. Always hungry. And he believed every ghost story.

scenes.title: Katrina Van Tassel
scenes.narration: He had his eye on Katrina Van Tassel, the rich farmer's daughter. Well... on her, and her father's pantry.

scenes.title: Brom Bones
scenes.narration: But Brom Bones wanted her too. And Brom meant to send Ichabod packing.

scenes.title: Ghost stories
scenes.narration: At the autumn party came ghost stories. Of a soldier whose head was shot away, who rides each night to find it.

scenes.title: Riding home
scenes.narration: Ichabod rode home alone on old Gunpowder. The woods went quiet.

scenes.title: A shadow
scenes.narration: Then, beside him, a huge dark rider. The moon broke through. He had no head.

scenes.title: The chase
scenes.narration: Ichabod kicked, and Gunpowder ran. Faster, faster, and the saddle slipped. Ahead, the bridge by the church. “If I can but reach that bridge, I am safe.”

scenes.title: The pumpkin
scenes.narration: He crossed, and looked back. The rider rose in his stirrups, and hurled his head. A blazing pumpkin!

scenes.title: Next morning
scenes.narration: At dawn, they found his hat by the bridge. Beside it, a shattered pumpkin. Ichabod was never seen again.

scenes.title: Brom laughs
scenes.narration: Soon after, Brom Bones married Katrina. Whenever the tale was told, he laughed. Especially at the part about the pumpkin.

scenes.title: Listen
scenes.narration: Ghost, or prank? Ride the Hollow at midnight, and listen.

scenes.title: Change the night
scenes.narration: Drawn in code with Galanty. Change a setting, change the night.
